project_type: Kiroween 2026 hackathon monorepo: Python news pipeline (pipeline/), Vite+TS globe (frontend/), Rust->WASM core (rebellion-core/), AWS SAM infra (infra/template.yaml), shared contract (schema/)
language: Python 3.13 venv (requires-python >=3.13, target py313) for all work in this task; YAML/JSON for infra; Markdown for docs
build_system: No Python build step; SAM for infra (sam CLI NOT installed). Frontend/Rust untouched by this task.
test_framework: pytest + hypothesis under pipeline/tests (test_agent_extract.py, test_binary.py, test_geolocate.py, test_pipeline.py, test_sources.py). Tests must never call Bedrock or the network: use stub agents (duck-typed objects with .extract(article) or structured_output) and stub boto3 clients.
verification_instructions: 1) .venv/bin/python -m pytest pipeline/tests -q (all green). 2) .venv/bin/ruff check pipeline/ 3) .venv/bin/black --check pipeline/. 4) python -c 'import json; json.load(open("infra/statemachine/rebellion.asl.json"))' once the ASL exists. sam validate is unavailable locally.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Committed demo snapshot: frontend/public/snapshots/latest/{snapshot.json,snapshot.bin}, copies at schema/fixtures/{snapshot.json,snapshot.bin} and rebellion-core/tests/fixtures/snapshot.bin. Official regen: .venv/bin/python -m pipeline.cli --out ./frontend/public/snapshots/latest --offline --date 2026-11-14 (requires valid AWS creds; local creds are INVALID so the preflight exits 2). Equivalent stub regen: transform.run(offline=True, report_date=date(2026,11,14), ready_check=lambda *a, **k: 'stub', extractor=<stub that raises if called>) then transform.write_artifacts(report, tmpdir) and compare to the committed files (only generated_at may differ). All 7 curated rows pin every required field so needs_agent() is False for all of them.
setup_instructions: Use the existing .venv (Python 3.13). strands, pydantic, boto3, botocore, pytest, hypothesis, ruff, black are installed. Run all commands from repo root /home/ssm-user/kiroween-2026-hackathon.
environment_constraints: Check whether the Rust toolchain is available first (`command -v cargo rustc wasm-pack`): if it is, run `cd rebellion-core && cargo test`; if not, do not install it and report the Rust checks as unverified. No sam, no cfn-lint. Local AWS credentials are invalid (InvalidClientTokenId). Network to RSS feeds works but tests must not use it. Do not deploy. Do not change binary layout v2, schema/, Rust, or frontend. Never add /.kiro to .gitignore. Do not delete files without the user's confirmation (report-ingestion-news.md must not be touched). Pre-existing unrelated working-tree changes: CLAUDE.md deleted and its content moved to untracked AGENTS.md, README.md modified, uv.lock and report-ingestion-news.md untracked. Do not commit.
contribution_requirements: Every artifact (code, comments, docs, identifiers, test names) in English. Follow ruff (E,F,I,B,UP,S; line-length 100) and black (line-length 100). Keep runtimes separated: Python only in pipeline/. Narrative terminology per .kiro/steering/narrative-tone.md (Machine Strike, Witness, Ground Zero, Insurgency Report, Rebellion Timeline).
